combined_events.evaluation_note: Each combo is checked independently at every one of the 5 tracked relative-strike levels (ATM-2..ATM+2), not ATM-only -- consistent with Part 2's strike-generic design. A combo can fire at more than one level in the same snapshot; each firing is its own event record.

non_overlapping_event_selection.rule: per (event_type, relative_strike, option_type, barrier_config), suppress new firings while a prior instance's holding window is still open
non_overlapping_event_selection.rationale: 53719 base / 6592 combined raw firings over 58 days indicate persistence across consecutive ~2min snapshots; labeling every firing pseudo-replicates one price path many times and inflates n

excluded_trading_days.2026-06-26: frozen/stale spot feed, std=0 across full session (Phase-2 audit finding)

flagged_trading_days.2026-06-22: double-cadence manual-collection artifact (Exp032 precedent), clock-based logic uses first-snapshot-at-or-after

walk_forward.generator_signature_note: calendar-day train/test window only; no validation split, no trading-day awareness -- both handled by exp033 fold-assembly code around the generator's output
walk_forward.calendar_days_correction_note: originally locked as 33/8/8 calendar days on the (wrong) assumption of ~1 trading day per calendar day; at this sample's actual ~0.72 trading-day/calendar-day density that left only ~23 trading days for a 25-day fit split, i.e. zero left for calibration. Corrected to 47/10/10 before any model was trained on real data (caught during Phase 8 dry-run, an implementation bug fix, not a threshold change) -- the trading-day targets below are unchanged.
